result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section right after "Longest Duplicates". The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or generate a report to look at the output.

- **Report section:** `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList` already existed in `DuplicationReportGenerator.java` but was never called. It already writes the description "The list of N most frequently found duplicates." and leaves the section out when there are none. I added the call, with the same stopwatch wrapping as the other sections.
- **Code links:** in `DataExporter.java`, when `saveCodeFragments` is on, the most frequent duplicates are now saved to `fragments/most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>`. These are the files the new table's "Code" links point to.
